The '''Krath war droid''' was a powerful [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] series created by the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]], an organization of [[darksider]]s founded by the corrupt [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].

==Description==
[[File:Krath_war_droid_Schematics.jpg|thumb|left|Schematics]]
Though Krath war droids were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in appearance, they could hunch down like animals and race at amazing speeds towards their targets, thanks to their gyro-balanced assembly systems. These [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were designed to surprise and overwhelm their enemies in devastating and deadly shock assaults. Despite being easy to manufacture, Krath war droids had limited cognitive matrices and were programmed only to seek and destroy the greatest threat on the battlefield. Krath war droids were thus often deployed in large numbers in order to overwhelm the enemy. Systemically identifying the greatest threat in range, the droids would swarm until the target was eliminated before moving on to the next most dangerous target.<ref name="NoP" />

They were armed with a melee combat [[short sword]] for hacking at close range and a [[Pulse-wave bow]] for long-range engagements. The attenuated induction spines on this weapon generated a pulse-wave charge and in a pinch could also be used as spear-like skewering/thrusting tools.<ref name="EGD" />

==History==
[[File:KrathWarDroid-TotJDLotS3.jpg|thumb|right||A Krath war droid]]
Following the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]/[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] defeat at the [[Battle of Koros Major]] in [[3997 BBY]], the Jedi held a a [[Conclave at Deneba|great assembly]] of ten thousand [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] on the planet [[Deneba/Legends|Deneba]]. The Krath saw this as an opportunity to test this new battle droid and to attack their enemies.

Their agents sabotaged the programming of the [[Service droid/Legends|servant droids]] that would be at the convocation. The Krath then loaded a [[Tetan Corsair]] with a hundred modified [[Escape pod/Legends|life pods]], which each carried a single war droid. Halfway into the Jedi assembly, the sabotaged servant droids suddenly [[Battle of Deneba|attacked]] their Jedi owners, causing much confusion and chaos. Meanwhile in orbit, the Tetan Corsair launched its life pods and an army of war droids emerged from the impact craters.

With the element of surprise on their side, the war droids charged at the assembled Jedi at frightening speeds and fired their pulse-wave firing assemblies. Soon, many Jedi fell to these mindless automatons. Jedi Master [[Arca Jeth]] fought back against them by using a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Ionize|technique]] he had discovered during the [[Great Droid Revolution]] to short-circuit them. However, he eventually fell to a plasma barrage. Though the Jedi had survived the assault, the death toll was appalling. Soon the Galactic Republic and the Jedi succeeded in defeating the Krath along with their [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] allies.

[[File:The_General.png|thumb|left|General Grievous]]
The Krath war droid later resurfaced in galactic history as the reference for the droid frame that would hold the biological remains of [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]], allowing him to become the feared [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Grievous's [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] droid elite were similarly modeled on the Krath war droid.

Grievous's Krath shell would also be reused in the [[N-K Project]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
